issues.issue: The governmental funds statement (p4) shows no special assessment revenue because the whole 9,118,165 is deferred (p3 'Unavailable revenue - special assessments'). Receipts follow the rules (fund statement), but the SID's main revenue source appears only on the government-wide statement; worth knowing when comparing SIDs.
Printed variance (24) doesn't match budget vs actual (should be 4); variance column is not extracted, actual 14 is correct. Printed irregularity only.

Detail amounts are budgetary basis and differ from the GAAP fund statement (e.g. taxes 9,733 vs 11,144; DS capital outlay 9,495,349 vs 7,872,047; warrants issued 9,806,022 vs 9,806,295). This is disclosed in notes and is the only actual column printed; flagged so the difference isn't read as a misread.
